name: Token value

subjectOf.text: The token economy is inflationary at equilibrium, and this inflation is a feature rather than a defect because it improves security and discourages rent seeking holding of reputation.
subjectOf.abstract: The conclusion is that the economy is inflationary at equilibrium, which improves its security and discourages rent-seeking.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Vlad Andrei, Blockchain Infrastructure for Measuring Domain Specific Reputation in Autonomous Decentralized and A (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3125822
scope_conditions: assumes fees keep entering the system and new tokens are minted with each fee

subjectOf.text: Sharing all work fees with the expertise creates a positive feedback loop: the more fees flow to the platform, the more reputation is worth, and the more workers prefer reputation tokens to one time fees.
subjectOf.abstract: Choosing to enforce a protocol where all fees are shared with the expertise creates a successful positive feedback loop: The more fees are sent to the platform, the more the reputation is worth; which means the reputation tokens will be more desirable to workers than one-time fees.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Mechanical Turk Through Verified Reputation (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3128900
scope_conditions: protocol enforces that users seeking validation send all work fees to the platform

subjectOf.text: All fees should be shared with the entire network of reputation holders in proportion to their holdings, because this reputational salary is what makes reputation tokens valuable and future-oriented.
subjectOf.abstract: All fees should be shared with the entire net- work of reputation holders relative to their holdings. This is the key to making reputa- tion tokens valuable and future-oriented.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, The Importance of Reputation for the Evolution of Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782210
